effect_description_eng:
＜Digisorption -3＞ (When one of your Digimon would digivolve into this card from your hand, you may suspend 1 of your Digimon to reduce the memory cost of the digivolution by 3.)
[Your Turn] For each of your other suspended Digimon, this Digimon gains ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
